comments: The diff says that the order is different
Damn, so subtle. Some sorting missing before comparison. Will send a PR with the fix.

review_comments: There is also instant query in the test, hence expected result as vector
But the type here should always be a Matrix.
Then why isn't the test failing? :)
Tried without @ modifier and an instant vector selector for an instant query returns a vector and not a matrix.

> Then why isn't the test failing? :)

Because in execEvalStmt we only sort the results of range queries.

It looks like the internal everything-is-matrix is also undone in execEvalStmt, so check is infact needed.
